channel.description: Aggregated rainfall, thunderstorm, and special forecasts from PAGASA VISPRSD

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 7 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 7 #VISPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 11:00 AM 18 August 2026

Red Warning: #OccidentalMindoro, #Palawan(Busuanga, Coron and Culion)
Associated Hazard: SERIOUS FLOODING is expected in low-lying areas and LANDSLIDES in mountainous areas.

Orange Warning: #Palawan(ElNido, Linapacan, Magsaysay, Agutaya, Cuyo, Taytay, Araceli, Dumaran) and #Antique(Caluya)
Associated Hazard: FLOODING IS THREATENING in low-lying areas and LANDSLIDES in mountainous areas.

Yellow Warning: #Palawan(SanVicente, Roxas, Cagayancillo), #Aklan(Malay, Buruanga, Nabas, Ibajay), #Antique(Libertad, Pandan), #Iloilo(Oton, IloiloCity, Pavia and Leganes)
Associated Hazard: FLOODING IS POSSIBLE in low-lying areas and LANDSLIDES in mountainous areas.

Meanwhile, Light to Moderate with occasionally Heavy rains are expected over #NegrosOccidental(SanEnrique, Valladolid, Pulupandan, BagoCity, BacolodCity, CadizCity), #Antique(Sebaste, Belison, SanRemigio, Culasi, Tibiao, Barbaza, LauaAn, Bugasong, Patnongon, Valderrama), #Iloilo(Alimodian, Maasin, Cabatuan, Mina, Pototan), #Guimaras, #Aklan(Tangalan, Malinao and Makato) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Palawan(Kalayaan, Balabac, Bataraza, Rizal, Brooke'sPoint, SofronioEspanola, Quezon, Narra, Aborlan, PuertoPrincesaCity), #NegrosOccidental(CityOfTalisay, SilayCity, EnriqueB.Magalona, Manapla, CityOfVictorias), #Iloilo(SanJoaquin, Leon, Tubungan, Miagao, Igbaras, Guimbal, Tigbauan, SanMiguel, NewLucena, SantaBarbara, BarotacNuevo, Dumangas, Zarraga), #Antique(TobiasFornier, AniniY, Hamtic, SanJose and Sibalom) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 02:00 PM Today.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 9 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 9 #VISPRSD
Issued at 12:32 PM 18 August 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Palawan(Bataraza, Narra, Rizal), #Aklan(Malinao), #Antique(Tibiao, Barbaza, Hamtic, Sibalom), #Capiz(Jamindan, Tapaz, Cuartero, Dumalag), #Iloilo(Bingawan, Calinog, CityOfPassi, SanEnrique, Banate, BarotacViejo, SanRafael, SanJoaquin, Miagao, Lemery, Sara, SanDionisio), #Guimaras(Buenavista, Jordan), #NegrosOccidental(CityOfVictorias, EnriqueB.Magalona, SilayCity, CityOfSipalay, Candoni and Ilog) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Palawan(Balabac, Quezon), #Antique(Culasi, Sebaste, AniniY, TobiasFornier), #Aklan(Madalag, Libacao), #Iloilo(Lambunao, Dueñas, Dingle, Anilao, BarotacNuevo, Dumangas, Pototan, Mina, Badiangan, Janiuay, Maasin, Cabatuan, NewLucena, Zarraga, Leganes, SantaBarbara, Pavia, Alimodian, SanMiguel, Leon, Tubungan, Igbaras, Guimbal, Ajuy, Concepcion), #Guimaras(NuevaValencia), #Capiz(Dumarao) and #NegrosOccidental(Cauayan) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Watch #VISPRSD
Issued at 10:00 AM 18 August 2026

Thunderstorm is MORE LIKELY to develop over #NegrosOccidental, #Iloilo, #Guimaras, #Antique, #Capiz, #Aklan, #OccidentalMindoro, #Palawan, #Cebu, #Bohol, #Siquijor, #NegrosOriental, #Leyte, #SouthernLeyte, #Biliran, #EasternSamar and #Samar within 12 hours.

All are advised to continue monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 8 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 8 #VISPRSD
Issued at 10:10 AM 18 August 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Antique(Patnongon), #Iloilo(Anilao, Pototan, Mina, Zarraga) and #NegrosOccidental(Pulupandan) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Antique(Valderrama), #Iloilo(BarotacNuevo, Dumangas, NewLucena, SantaBarbara), #Guimaras(Buenavista, SanLorenzo) and #NegrosOccidental(BagoCity) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
